images.title: The seven tangram pieces sorted by sides
images.purpose: Show the 7 tangram pieces in two trays, 5 triangles (2 large, 1 medium, 2 small) that have 3 sides and 2 pieces (a square and a parallelogram) that have 4 sides, with right angles marked, and the total 5 + 2 = 7.
images.composition: Two trays side by side. The wide left tray holds the 5 triangles in a row, from the 2 large to the 1 medium to the 2 small, and the right tray holds the square and the parallelogram. The sum is written large at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816, drawn to scale (the small triangle has 90 px legs, the square has 90 px sides). CAPTION at the top: The 7 tangram pieces sorted by number of sides, bold dark #1F2937 sans-serif, 38 px, centred at (728,100). LEFT TRAY: one rounded rectangle in grey #6B7280, 4 px outline, no fill, from x 80 to 911 and y 230 to 540, with its heading 3 sides: 5 pieces (bold dark, 40 px) centred at (495,190). Inside it exactly 5 triangular pieces in a row, all with their right-angle corner at the bottom left and their flat side on the base line y 470, each with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px) and 26 px gaps between pieces: large triangle with corners (110,470), (290,470) and (110,290), filled #0072B2; large triangle with corners (316,470), (496,470) and (316,290), filled #0072B2; medium triangle with corners (522,470), (649,470) and (522,343), filled #E69F00; small triangle with corners (675,470), (765,470) and (675,380), filled #009E73; small triangle with corners (791,470), (881,470) and (791,380), filled #009E73. Under each triangle a small tag in dark text, 28 px: large at (200,510), large at (406,510), medium at (585,510), small at (720,510), small at (836,510). Inside the bottom left corner of each of the 5 triangles exactly 1 right-angle mark, a small square outline 16 px by 16 px (thin dark, 3 px), so exactly 5 marks in this tray. RIGHT TRAY: one rounded rectangle in grey #6B7280, 4 px outline, no fill, from x 960 to 1337 and y 230 to 540, with its heading 4 sides: 2 pieces (bold dark, 40 px) centred at (1148,190). Inside it exactly 2 pieces on the same base line y 470: a square with corners (990,470), (1080,470), (1080,380) and (990,380), filled reddish purple #CC79A7; and a slanted parallelogram with corners (1116,470), (1243,470), (1307,406) and (1180,406), filled vermilion #D55E00, whose 2 long sides are 127 px and whose 2 short sides are 90 px. Tags in dark text, 28 px: square at (1035,510) and parallelogram at (1211,510). Inside each of the 4 corners of the square exactly 1 right-angle mark (a small square outline 16 px by 16 px, thin dark, 3 px), so exactly 4 marks on the square; the parallelogram has no right-angle mark. BOTTOM: the text 5 + 2 = 7 in bold dark, 84 px, centred at (728,650), the largest text in the frame. Exactly 7 coloured pieces in all, 9 right-angle marks in all, 2 trays. Nothing else in the frame.

images.takeaway: The 7 pieces sort into 5 triangles with 3 sides and 2 four-sided pieces, and 5 + 2 = 7.
images.description: The seven tangram pieces in two trays: 5 triangles (2 large, 1 medium, 2 small) and 2 four-sided pieces (a square and a parallelogram), with 5 + 2 = 7.
images.context: Concept image for The Seven Tangram Pieces. It follows the idea of the tangram picture in your maths book (a square cut into 7 pieces) and shows the concept's own sort of the 7 pieces by their number of sides.
images.teaching_notes: Let the child count the sides of each piece before the sort. Then ask which pieces are the same shape in different sizes: the 5 triangles are.

image_decisions.why: The 7 pieces in two trays, with the right angles marked, show the 5 + 2 sort by sides and the shape of each piece.
